Name: The Fish of Legend
Author: JamesClawk
Description:
[size=3][b]Description[/b][/size]
The Fish of Legend adds new events when you bring a legendary fish to Willy's shop. It will boost your friendship with him, he will give you rewards, and you can ask him to tell you the legend of the fish you bring him. (He will not take the fish. You keep it) There are config options available for you to customize the amount of rewards you are given.

There is an intro event (available once you reach fishing level 3), an event for each of the five legendary fish, and a finale event once you've seen every other event.

[size=3][b]Rewards
[/b][/size]For each of the Legendary fish, excluding Legend, Willy will give you 2000g, a dish o' the sea, and half a friendship heart with him. Legend rewards 3000g, a pearl and one friendship heart with Willy. There are config options to reduce/increase the amount of money and/or friendship you receive, but the item is always the same. (enabling AllSkippable in the config and skipping events will result in you not receiving some rewards)

If you have any ideas for more interesting rewards, feel free to let me know.

[size=3][b]Notes
[/b][/size]I do not currently have plans to implement similar events for the Legendary II fish, but if you'd like to see them added, please let me know.

My mod states that none of these fish have ever been caught, and implies that they are one-of-a-kind. This may conflict with the lore of other mods or seem contradictory if you have a mod which allows you to catch multiple of each legendary fish. If people are particularly bothered by this, I can implement a config option to change these lines.
